title: Reverse Gravity Item Consumable Mechanic
description: Implemented reverse_gravity_item properly as an Area of Effect (AoE) consumable instead of a self-buff. When a ball uses it, it now spawns a reverse_gravity_field hazard that pushes enemies up and outwards in a radius, granting them a reverse_gravity_timer penalty for gravity inversion physics. Backward compatibility was maintained for reverse_gravity_pad which utilizes the self-buff behavior of reverse_gravity_item_timer.
